classification_rule: q < 0.5 predicts removable ONLY for diagnostic classification; equality predicts necessary; never authorizes deletion
domain_rule: Use actual new domain for predict(); it must abstain. Separately inspect the frozen cell/prior numerically as an out-of-domain diagnostic, never relabel the domain to bypass predict().
feature_rule: Frozen extractor only; discarded_result is explicit source metadata for whether the marked region provides a returned scalar, independently of side effects; limited_probe_pass is the sole permitted paired observation before predictions are sealed.
labels: After sealing all features/predictions, exhaustively compare original/deleted complete returned values or exception type/message over each finite Cartesian domain. Unsupported extraction is abstention, never a negative label.
observations: Finite programs have fresh local state only; returned payload includes any contracted persistent-state proxy. No claim about arbitrary data, real DB effects, divergence or environment.
real_review: Three source-bound modules from existing decompiled BenchBase classes, not used in feature fitting; manually audit required effects under a retained committed-state contract. No executable labels without new differential execution; all real scores abstain.
metrics: diagnostic Brier/log loss vs frozen 0.5 prior
diagnostic false-removal and false-retention counts with denominators
independence: New standalone sources, authored by the same researcher with development results known; NOT independently collected/blind external benchmark. Shared source groups forbid treating programs/modules as independent real-world population samples.
freeze: Archive model, extractor, predictor, protocol, corpus, source metadata, runner and real source files with SHA256 before executing any case. No fit() call, no threshold or feature tuning.
stop: One fixed 16-program challenge and three source audits. Preserve errors/failures. No performance run or further corpus expansion this round.
